property_summary: For every non-empty destination array, transferring through c must invoke transferFrom on the counterparty exactly once for each element of _tos, so when _tos has length 2 the recorded total match count must be 2, but the buggy version initializes the loop at 1 and records only 1 call, violating this universal per-element rule.
change_summary: Initialize the loop counter to 1, skipping the first destination address.
